_comment: Reference template for Prompt-Studio Lean — copy the 'hooks' object into your .qoder/settings.json or ~/.qoder/settings.json. Replace LEAN_DIR with the path to your Prompt-Studio checkout (e.g. ~/.qoder/plugins/prompt-studio or the install path). Requires python3 (or python) on PATH.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "LEAN_DIR/hooks/lean_mode_tracker.py" || exec python "LEAN_DIR/hooks/lean_mode_tracker.py"'
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "LEAN_DIR/hooks/lean_subagent.py" || exec python "LEAN_DIR/hooks/lean_subagent.py"'
